versions.changelog:
Initial release of the industry ROI calculator.

- Generates ROI analysis cards tailored to industry, company size, scenario, and current cost.
- Provides recommended PoC scope, core metrics, and success benchmarks for presales and internal evaluation.
- Outputs structured risk assumptions and industry-scenario benchmark cases (de-identified).
- Uses industry-standard cost and benefit models for human resource, AI investments, and efficiency/quality gains.
- Clearly indicates output boundaries and confidence levels based on input completeness.
